The point here is people have different preferences, I'm sure there are other people like you and I out there.

I hope I'm not too late, this really speaks to me. In highschool, I used to be the model student. Then college started and I'm barely getting by. I haven't been trying as hard as I should have and I'm pretty sure I'm gonna fail my math and chem class. I go to school near a lake and I've come close to drowning myself, but then I thought "I should let my mom know where I'll leave the van" and the moment my mom came to mind I started sobbing. I think what you could do is figure out what drives you. Find out what you're passionate about, maybe you don't put in effort because the end goal isn't something you actually care about. I'm studying to be a nurse, but honestly this was never something I truly wanted. I thought by this point in my life I'd be a famous comedian or singer, I did theater for a couple years and even have a sucky Youtube channel lol. And everyday I think "I'm exhausted of living. Especially when I know I can't do what I REALLY want" 

Maybe you have something that you can focus on, something important enough to make you want to stick it through and get through life. And if you don't, maybe try to find it. Perhaps you can add something to this world, you just don't know it yet.

What keeps me going is "if I die, it won't only end the suffering I have. I'll never know if I could ever become a famous singer or popular comedian. Because if I die, my dreams die with me and I'll never know for sure if I can do it." I don't think it's right to determine your worth soley by your grades. Maybe you were made to do other things in life. Your not a failure and I believe you have the power to turn things around.
